abstract: Withdrawal StatementThe authors have withdrawn this manuscript because additional controls did not confirm the involvement of LSM1 in NMD. Our initial conclusions were based on wrong assumptions about the used degron system and the required controls. RNA sequencing, phenotype and RT-qPCR results are affected, but other results presented in the manuscript remain valid. We apologize to the colleagues who based any of their work or conclusion on that part of the preprint. Therefore, the authors do not wish this work to be cited as reference for the project. If you have any questions, please contact the corresponding author.
